bwGuide.changeBody: 按下編輯欄位,點擊預覽中的任一欄位並選擇項目。將欄位設為(空白),相鄰的欄位就會擴展到空出的那一列,因此精簡後的版面會得到更大的數字,而不是留下空隙。套用會將它寫入記憶卡。
bwGuide.installBody: 開啟遙控器電源、連接 USB,在其螢幕上選擇 USB Storage (SD),然後在這裡按安裝。ArduDeck 會複製腳本,並讓每個型號的遙測畫面都指向它,因此遙控器上不需要設定任何東西。
bwGuide.listenBody: 無論遙測畫面是否開啟,語音播報都會播放,所以你可以邊看著飛行器:遙測連上與中斷、電池門檻、圍欄與 EKF 警告。解鎖播報會保持靜默,直到載具實際回報已解鎖狀態,而不是猜測。
bwGuide.openBody: 退出記憶卡、拔掉 USB,然後在主畫面按 PAGE,直到出現 ArduDeck 畫面。它與遙控器其他的遙測畫面放在一起。
bwGuide.readBody: 頂部列:飛行模式、解鎖計時器、連結品質。底部列:載具自身的訊息。兩者之間的一切都是欄位:大型讀數、左側欄、地平線(或另外兩個資料欄)以及右側欄。訊號數值前的 S 表示數值來自 EdgeTX 自身的感測器,而非 passthrough。

bwPreview.editingHint: 點擊任一欄位以選擇其顯示內容;將其設為(空白),相鄰的欄位就會擴展到該空間。
bwPreview.flipPagesTip: 點擊以翻頁(遙控器上的旋鈕 / +/-)
bwPreview.pageHint: 第 {{page}}/2 頁,點擊以翻頁(遙控器上的旋鈕或 +/-)。狀態列之間的所有內容都是可編輯的欄位:大型讀數、兩側欄,以及中央面板(地平線或另外兩個資料欄)。

radioHudView.appliedAll: 已套用到此遙控器上的每個型號。拔掉前請先退出。
radioHudView.appliedBw: 已套用。{{count}} 個型號已設定遙測畫面,請退出、拔掉,然後在遙控器上按 PAGE。
radioHudView.appliedModel: 僅套用到型號「{{model}}」。拔掉遙控器前請先退出。
radioHudView.applyTip: 安裝/重新整理小工具,並將此版面寫入 SD 卡。之後在遙控器上:App layout、全螢幕小工具、ArduDeck
radioHudView.deleteTip: 從 ArduDeck 刪除「{{name}}」。遙控器上已有的內容不受影響。
radioHudView.demoTip: 未連線時,遙控器會播放一段腳本化飛行並附語音播報,標示為 DEMO。也可以點擊 NO LINK 畫面切換
radioHudView.detectedSwitchTip: 已插入的遙控器會在 RADIO/radio.yml 中表明自己的身分;若套用到錯誤的螢幕類別,會安裝遙控器無法使用的檔案
radioHudView.dragHint: 拖曳以移動,拖曳角落握把以調整大小(8px 吸附)。頂部列與訊息跑馬燈是固定的。
radioHudView.ejectNeedsRestart: 退出需要重新啟動應用程式才會啟用(新功能)
radioHudView.ejectTip: 安全退出 SD 磁碟區,讓遙控器可以離開 USB 儲存模式
radioHudView.ejected: 已退出。請拔掉遙控器;小工具會在幾秒內重新載入其設定。
radioHudView.everyModelOnRadio: 此遙控器上的每個型號
radioHudView.everyModelUses: - 除非有自己的版面,否則每個型號都使用此版面
radioHudView.fieldMapsTip: 地圖圖磚用的離線衛星影像。點擊你的場地;圓環顯示各縮放層級的涵蓋範圍
radioHudView.guideTip: HUD 在單色遙控器上如何運作:安裝、開啟、解讀
radioHudView.inputDebug: 在遙控器上顯示輸入除錯
radioHudView.inputDebugTip: 顯示遙控器傳給小工具的資料:是否全螢幕、最後一次按鍵事件值、最後一次觸控,以及目前顯示的頁面。用於找出按鈕為何沒反應。

radioHudView.layoutsTip: 版面存放在 ArduDeck 中,編輯時會自動儲存。遙控器只會取得你套用的那一個。
radioHudView.loadFromRadioTip: 將 SD 卡上目前的設定與圖磚版面讀入編輯器
radioHudView.loadFromVehicleTip: 用已連線載具的參數填入欄位
radioHudView.loadedFromCache: 已從快取的參數載入(載具目前未連線)
radioHudView.loadedShared: 已載入每個型號共用的版面。
radioHudView.lookingForRadioHint: 正在尋找遙控器。請透過 USB 連接,並在其螢幕上選擇 USB Storage (SD);出現需要幾秒鐘。
radioHudView.mapsNeedCenter: 請先設定場地中心(連接載具或輸入座標)
radioHudView.mapsReady: 就緒:{{zooms}} 個縮放層級,隨下次套用一併送出
radioHudView.mapsReadyMissing: 就緒({{zooms}} 個縮放層級),缺少 {{missing}} 個圖磚:請在應用程式地圖上瀏覽此區域一次以快取,然後重新產生
radioHudView.newLayoutTip: 在 ArduDeck 中開始新版面。目前的版面已儲存。

radioHudView.noOwnLayout: 「{{model}}」還沒有自己的版面,因此這是共用版面。

radioHudView.noRadioYet: 還沒有遙控器。請在遙控器上選擇 USB Storage (SD);仍在尋找中。
radioHudView.noVehicleData: 尚無載具資料,請先連接載具一次,以便讀取其參數
radioHudView.onlyModelUses: - 只有「{{model}}」使用此版面,其餘維持共用版面
radioHudView.pageTip: 第 {{n}} 頁,在遙控器上滑動即可到達
radioHudView.previewTip: 以所選遙控器的解析度忠實呈現版面與顏色;遙控器使用自己的字型繪製
radioHudView.radioModelTip: 遙控器型號:版面會依其螢幕縮放
radioHudView.removeTip: 從 SD 卡刪除 ArduDeck 小工具及其設定(僅限我們安裝的檔案)
radioHudView.renameTip: 重新命名此版面。儲存是自動的。
radioHudView.resetTip: 將每個欄位恢復為預設版面

radioHudView.useVehiclePositionTip: 以載具目前所在位置為場地中心
radioHudView.widgetConfigTip: 這裡的一切都是覆寫值。保持自動時,小工具會依載具遙測自行設定,不需要 ArduDeck 或飛控連線
radioHudView.widgetRemoved: 小工具已從遙控器移除(包含設定)。

studio.screensHint: What the radio shows. Click a tile to change it.
studio.bwScreenHint: Fixed layout; pick what each slot shows.
studio.templatesHint: A template is a full set of screens. Pick one, then change any tile.
studio.switchingWhy: A widget on a normal radio screen gets no touch, so it turns by itself:
studio.onlySwipe: only by swiping in full screen

copter.name: Copter
copter.desc: Battery, height, home, GPS and the horizon. Then the mission map.

fpv.name: FPV
fpv.desc: A large horizon with link and battery beside it.

rangefinder.name: Rangefinder work
rangefinder.desc: Distance to the ground first, for low and close flying. Then systems.

plane.name: Plane
plane.desc: Speed, height, horizon, GPS and wind. Then a navigation screen.

longRange.name: Long range
longRange.desc: Link and home distance next to the map. Then systems.

rover.name: Rover
rover.desc: Heading tape, speedometer, roll and pitch, battery and throttle with reverse. Then the mission map and systems.

sub.name: Sub
sub.desc: Heading tape, depth with the bottom below, the artificial horizon, battery and link. Then systems.

bigPicture.name: Big picture
bigPicture.desc: Horizon and map side by side.

minimal.name: Minimal
minimal.desc: Battery, home distance, link and time as four equal large readouts, readable at arm length.

survey.name: Survey
survey.desc: Map with the next waypoint, battery and time, for mapping runs. Then systems.

cinematic.name: Cinematic
cinematic.desc: A calm horizon line with home and battery, for filming.

cruise.name: Cruise
cruise.desc: Speed, height and home over a horizon line. Then navigation.

thermal.name: Thermal
thermal.desc: Height with climb rate and the wind next to the map, for soaring. Then systems.

missionDrive.name: Mission drive
missionDrive.desc: Map with a speedometer and the next waypoint, for driving a mission. Then systems.

fieldWork.name: Field work
fieldWork.desc: Map with run time and battery, for mowing and field rounds. Then driving.

boat.name: Boat
boat.desc: Heading tape, speedometer, depth under the hull, battery and link. Then sounding and systems.

sounding.name: Sounding
sounding.desc: The echogram beside a bottom profile and speed, for sounding runs. Needs a script on the boat, set up in one click. Then the boat screen.

studio.dragHint: Drag on the screen to move it, drag the corner to resize.
studio.pickATile: Click a tile on the screen to change or remove it.

tileHelp.batt: Charge left, voltage per cell and current. The bar uses the cells and capacity on the right.
tileHelp.home: Distance and bearing to home, with an arrow pointing to it.
tileHelp.alt: Height above home and climb rate. A rover or boat shows the distance driven instead, a sub its depth.
tileHelp.att: Roll and pitch, as a horizon or as numbers.
tileHelp.wind: Wind speed and direction as the flight controller estimates it.
tileHelp.link: Link quality and signal strength from the receiver.
tileHelp.imu: Temperature of the flight controller's IMU.
tileHelp.rng: Rangefinder distance. On a boat it reads as depth.
tileHelp.map: Satellite map with the vehicle, home and the mission route. Needs field maps, below.
tileHelp.wp: Next waypoint: number, distance and bearing.
tileHelp.speedo: Ground speed in km/h on an arc gauge. The scale grows with the highest speed seen.
tileHelp.heading: Compass tape with the heading boxed in the middle and the next waypoint marked in blue.
tileHelp.depth: Water column: the surface on top, a sub at its depth, the bottom from the downward rangefinder or sonar. On a boat, the depth under the hull.
tileHelp.roll: Side-to-side lean as a land meter: the vehicle stays upright, the ground tilts. Amber from 20 degrees, red from 30.
tileHelp.pitch: Nose up or down as a land meter: the vehicle stays upright, the ground tilts. Amber from 20 degrees, red from 30.
tileHelp.echo: Fish-finder waterfall from a Blue Robotics Ping: echo strength over the water column, newest on the right. Needs a script on the boat; ArduDeck sets it up in one click.
tileHelp.bottom: Depth over the last minutes as a seabed line, from any depth sounder. No script needed.

sonar.needsScriptTitle: The echogram needs a script on the boat
sonar.connectFirst: ArduDeck installs a small Lua script on the autopilot that reads the Ping and sends the echogram to the radio. Connect the boat once to set it up.
sonar.readyBody: ArduDeck installs the ArduDeck sonar script on the autopilot, hands the Ping's serial port to it (the depth keeps working through the script) and restarts the autopilot. These settings change:
sonar.plusScripting: plus SCR_ENABLE and SCR_HEAP_SIZE if scripting is off

phase.uploading: Copying the script to the autopilot
phase.verifying: Waiting for the script to start

sonar.installedBody: The autopilot reads the Ping and sends the echogram. Put these screens on the radio to see it.
sonar.companionTitle: The companion computer owns the sonar
sonar.companionBody: Depth arrives over MAVLink, so a companion computer such as BlueOS runs the Ping. The radio cannot get an echogram this way; the Sonar cargo shows it in ArduDeck.
sonar.noneBody: The echogram needs a Blue Robotics Ping wired to the autopilot and set up as a rangefinder. Hardware setup has a preset for it.
sonar.manualBody: The autopilot did not take the file over the link. Copy ardudeck_sonar.lua to {{path}} on its SD card, then run the setup again; nothing else was changed.
sonar.nmeaBody: An NMEA sounder sends the depth only, so the radio can show depth and the bottom profile but no echogram. The echogram needs a Blue Robotics Ping.

studio.snapTip: Snap tiles to the 8 px grid and to their neighbours while dragging.

guide.installBody: Connect the radio over USB and choose USB Storage (SD) on its screen. ArduDeck finds it, and the button at the bottom copies the widget and your screens to the SD card. Eject before you unplug.
guide.placeBody: Once per model, on the radio: open the Screens setup, choose a layout with one large area, and add the ArduDeck widget to it. In full screen you can swipe between your screens.
guide.telemetryBody: The widget reads ArduPilot passthrough telemetry. With FrSky, set the receiver's serial port to SERIALn_PROTOCOL = 10. With CRSF or ExpressLRS, turn on RC_OPTIONS bit 8 (passthrough for CRSF telemetry). Then let the radio discover new sensors.
guide.statesHint: What the radio shows instead of your screens, and what to check.

state.no-link: NO LINK: the radio hears nothing from the receiver. Check that the receiver has power and is bound.
state.no-mavlink: NO MAVLINK: the link is up but no telemetry frames arrive. Check the passthrough setting, or ELRS MAVLink mode.
state.streams-off: STREAMS OFF: frames arrive but the flight controller sends too little. Connect ArduDeck once to set the telemetry rates.
